messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "given for at least five days before the dose is increased"
set: ["given for at least five days before the dose is increased", "at least five days", "after five days", "talk to your doctor before dose is increased", "wait at least 14 days after stopping before starting MAOI", "stop using for at least 48 hours before test", "take a single dose at least 2 hours before exercise for exercise-induced bronchoconstriction", "exercising at least 30 minutes most days", "take at least 8 hours before aspirin", "take at least 4 hours before resin", "requirement applies after at least 30 days on 7 mg dose", "dose is given in 3 divided doses", "first dose given 30 minutes before the start of emetogenic chemotherapy", "stop biotin and biotin-containing supplements at least 2 days before thyroid blood test", "take the missed dose if it is within 4 days after the missed dose", "do not take another dose for at least 24 hours"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
